'''Raul ("Raulzinho") Togni Neto''' ([[Belo Horizonte]], May 19, 1992) is a [[Brazil]]ian [[basketball]] player. He's 1.84m [6'2] tall and he's a member of the [[Brazil national basketball team]]. He plays for the [[San Sebastián Gipuzkoa BC|Lagun Aro GBC]] in the [[Liga ACB|Spanish league]].

==Pro career==
Raulzinho first played pro basketball as 17 year old in 2009-2010 NBB season. In 2010, he was selected to play for the World Team at the [[Nike Hoop Summit]].

After averaging 12.61 points and 2.61 assists in under 28 minutes as a 6th man for [[Minas Tênis Clube]] in the [[2010–2011 NBB season|2010–11 NBB season]], he signed for [[San Sebastián Gipuzkoa BC|Lagun Aro GBC]] of [[Spain]].

==Brazil national team==
He started to get attention after leading Brazil Under 18 Team to an impressive runners up showing in 2010 FIBA Americas U18.<ref>[http://www.draftexpress.com/article/FIBA-Americas-U-18-Championships-Top-International-Prospects-3528/ draftexpress.com] Draft Express. FIBA Americas U-18 Championships: Top International Prospects.
